name: Toolfolio
summary: Curated directory and marketplace to discover AI, design, no-code and productivity tools.
description: A curated directory where people discover software tools across categories such as design, AI, no-code, marketing, video and coding. Tools are listed with tags and vendor notes, grouped into numbered collections ('32 Best Vibe Coding Assistants in 2026') and covered in review articles; makers submit tools and can claim them for free or pay for boosted listings.
contains: categories include design, AI, no-code, marketing, video, e-commerce, coding, audio, productivity and agents
curated collections such as '32 Best Vibe Coding Assistants in 2026' and '31 Best Popular Icon Libraries in 2026'
review and explainer articles on individual tools
free tool claims plus paid listing tiers: Startup $150 one-time, Growth $2,500/yr, ad packs from $400/mo
coupon codes, a 'Tools Daily' feed and library integrations for Figma, Framer, Notion, Webflow, Shopify and Chrome
